$comment: Worker bookkeeping tables in public (ADR-0013 §4, ADR-0004 item 4; data-model §3.5 as added by TASK-039 and TASK-043): job_executions, the idempotency ledger of job effects (REQ-PLAT-014), and processed_events, the (consumer, event_id) dedupe of outbox consumers (REQ-PLAT-017). SYSTEM: no org_id and no RLS (a scheduled job has no organisation; a tenant job's organisation comes from platform.job_context, TASK-047). Owner module worker: eslint SYSTEM_MODEL_OWNERS maps it to apps/worker/src/platform/**. Grants (prisma/sql/grants.manifest; data-model §4.4, D-ARCH-171): platform_app SELECT, INSERT, DELETE on both; never UPDATE (a row is written once, in the effect's transaction). hardDelete (TASK-043): the daily outbox-purge job deletes job_executions completed and processed_events processed more than 30 days ago. stdColumns: the full standard-column set, written by a runtime role, so the standard-columns guard trigger is rendered.
